tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Website background: web-only, one step darker than night. Every ratio below is measured on it.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Website text: near-white and almost hueless. Body, headings and names alike; headings differ by weight. 16.3:1 on bg, 14.4:1 on lid.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary website text: section labels, numerals, dates, captions, nav at rest, link underlines, footer. Neutral gray, 6.0:1 on bg, 5.3:1 on lid.

tokens.name: lid
tokens.usage: The one raised panel (code blocks, notes, kbd, image wells, the photo panel's backing) and every border: table rows, the Callout's edge, outline buttons. From the theme (status bar, popups).

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The selection background, and the Callout's edge on hover. From the theme (selection, line numbers).

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: The dimmest readable gray: code comments (italic) and punctuation, the $ prompt, docs group labels. 3.8:1 on bg, so never for content.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: The middle gray of code: strings, members, namespaces, operators, built-in types, attributes, doc comments. 7.2:1 on bg, 6.4:1 on lid.

color.note: Seven colors: three web neutrals and four grays from eyesclosed. No hue anywhere on the page.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: A native macOS terminal that remembers every session.
styles.usage: The one large line per page: the hero statement, or a docs page's h1. Fluid: 24px on phones to 30px on wide screens. fg.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Building and operating software today spans local machines, remote hosts and production systems.
styles.usage: Everything you read. Fluid: 16px on phones, 18px at 1024, 20px from 1440 (line height 1.55). Section labels in fg-muted.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings, names and entry titles: body size (fluid with it), set apart by weight 500 only.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Creator of Macterm. Previously at Huddle Surety.
styles.usage: Notes, tables, the docs sidebar, bios beside a picture. fg or fg-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, and inline code at 0.85em. The only mono anywhere. Fira Code keeps its ligatures.

spacing.note: A 4px base, used generously. Space is the only separator.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its paragraph; list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Code and note padding; gap beside a thumbnail.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs and blocks inside a section; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between entries with photos; page gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop (left edge of the column).

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Above the footer.

tokens.name: space-50
tokens.usage: Below the hero statement.

tokens.name: space-70
tokens.usage: Above the hero statement on desktop (160px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code blocks, kbd, notes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Media and the photo panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The callout and buttons.

size.note: The page always reaches both edges of the window: a left-aligned text column, and on desktops a Stage filling the rest with the product itself.

tokens.name: width-text
tokens.usage: The text column (about 72 characters at desktop size), left-aligned at the page gutter. Never centred.

tokens.name: width-sidebar
tokens.usage: Docs index, pinned 64px from the window's left edge at full height; the docs page follows it 64px later.

tokens.name: inset-stage
tokens.usage: Gap between the Stage and the window edges on desktops (1024px and up), where the Stage fills everything right of the text column, at least 30vw.
